changes: FAST downloads: covers and lyrics now download several songs at a time over one shared fast connection — no more one-by-one waiting
Equalizer redesigned, PixelPlayer style: preset chips, tall vertical band sliders, and round dials for Bass Boost, Virtualizer and Loudness with on/off switches
Save your own equalizer presets: set the bands, tap Save in the equalizer, name it — long-press a saved preset to delete it
Virtualizer effect added (where the phone supports it)
Album art resolution setting (Settings, My Library): Low 512px (fastest), Medium 800px, High 1200px
Animated lyrics on/off and a lyric blur strength slider (Settings, Player & Lyrics)
New app icons: your purple Dhunn icons — Purple Note (default) and Headphones, in Settings, Appearance, App icon
New: Download lyrics for all songs in one tap (Settings, My Library) — lyrics are saved on the phone and work fully offline
New: Auto-refresh — new songs are picked up automatically and you get a 'New song added' notification
New: Open songs from your file manager — Dhunn now appears in the 'Open with' player list and plays the file at once
New: Skip short voice clips — hide voice notes and short clips (15/30/45/60s) so only songs stay. Settings → My Library
New: Songs folder — pick one folder and only its songs appear in the library
Player themes removed — the player is back to its clean classic look
Fixed: music stopping by itself in the background — new fix options in Settings → Equalizer & Playback (battery permission + auto-start), and closing the app from recents no longer stops playback
Fluid Beat is back inside the player only (the whole-app fluid background was removed)
Fluid Beat now fills the WHOLE app: pick it as the player background and the liquid beat follows you through Home, Search and Library
HD cover downloads keep going in the background with a progress notification — and if you stop or close the app, the job RESUMES where it left off
12 PRO player themes: Neon Nights, Sunset Vibes, Royal Gold, Candy Pop, Arctic Frost and more — Settings → Player & Lyrics → Player theme
Four app icon variants: Emerald, Ocean, Sunset and Violet — switch in Settings → Appearance → App icon
The logo inside the app now follows your theme colour
New app icon: a musical note that matches the name Dhunn
Same emerald look, fresh melody mark
In-app updates: Dhunn now checks GitHub for new versions and shows an update message automatically
New Updates & FAQs section in Settings with the full changelog
FAQs and changelog are controlled from GitHub — no app release needed to edit them
The app has a new name: Dhunn
11 album art styles for the player — Vinyl Disc, Spotify Card, CD, Sleeve & Disc, Polaroid, Glass, Poster, Tilt 3D, Cassette, Minimal and more
New art style gallery with a live animated preview
You can now clear your recently played history and your search history
The intro now explains every permission and what it is used for
Fluid Beat pulse is stronger — you can really feel the beat now
App theme colour follows the playing song's cover
Tapping the Search tab again opens the keyboard instantly
Fluid Beat rebuilt: background colours come from the album cover
Real beat sync — the background moves with the actual music
Removed the notch mini player
One-tap HD covers: download high-quality covers for all your songs from Settings
Dhunn now remembers your song and the exact position when you close the app — reopen and press play to continue right where you left off
Brand new app icon
120 lyrics effects with a searchable gallery — including the favourite Blur Focus
HD album covers download automatically for songs with missing or low-quality art
App is now English only
Lyrics you fetch once are saved and work offline
Keyboard and stability fixes
App size cut down to just 9.5 MB
Faster startup
Beautiful glass-style lyrics view
The app greets you by your name
Fixed album art in notifications
Fluid Beat animated background
Lyrics Manager: add your own lyrics from a file or write them yourself
Spotify-style design
Themes, custom accent colours and player styles
5-band equalizer
First release — a fully offline music player with your own songs, playlists, liked songs and synced lyrics

faqs.a: Yes — Dhunn is completely free. No ads, no subscriptions, no locked features.
No. Your songs play fully offline from your phone. Internet is only used for lyrics, HD cover images and checking for updates.
faqs.q: Does Dhunn need an internet connection?

faqs.a: Only for the Fluid Beat background: the app listens to the music's beat (not your voice) to animate the background. Nothing is ever recorded or sent anywhere.
faqs.q: Why does Dhunn ask for microphone permission?

faqs.a: When a new version is released, Dhunn shows an update message automatically. You can also check any time in Settings → Updates & FAQs → Check for updates.
Make sure you allowed the Music & audio permission, then go to Settings → My Library and scan your device again.
faqs.q: My songs are not showing up. What do I do?

faqs.a: Yes. Open the song, tap the edit (pencil) icon near the lyrics, and pick a lyrics file or write/paste your own. Your lyrics are saved and used offline.
faqs.q: Lyrics are missing for a song. Can I add my own?

faqs.a: No. There is no account, no sign-up and no tracking. Your music and your data never leave your phone.
faqs.q: Does Dhunn collect my personal data?

faqs.a: While a song is playing, tap the style icon at the top of the player — or go to Settings → Player & Lyrics → Album art style. There are 11 styles with a live preview.
faqs.q: How do I change the album art style?

latest.notes: Much faster cover & lyrics downloads, a PixelPlayer-style equalizer with round Bass/Virtualizer/Loudness dials and custom presets, and an album art resolution setting.
